name: nextlevel-pos-firebase
description: Firebase migration workspace (Hosting + Firestore + Functions) for Next Level Family Restaurant POS

scripts.test:emulator: npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration && npm run test:hosting
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:shim && npm run test:emulator
scripts.emulators:functions: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.etl:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-nextlevel-etl "node scripts/etl-firestore.mjs --source scripts/fixtures/etl-source.sqlite --target emulator --create-auth-users --project demo-nextlevel-etl"
